name: Nasdaq Data Link
tagline: Market and alternative datasets via REST from Nasdaq Data Link
description: Nasdaq Data Link (formerly Quandl) provides a REST API for time-series and table datasets covering markets, economics, and alternative data. Developers authenticate with an API key, query named datasets, and receive JSON or CSV for analysis, backtesting, and research workflows.

auth.details: API key via query parameter api_key=YOUR_API_KEY or Authorization header; free self-serve signup at data.nasdaq.com

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free tier available with limited calls; exact limits vary by plan—verify on account page
pricing.paid_plans: Usage-based and subscription plans for premium datasets and higher limits

rate_limits: not published precisely for free tier; check account dashboard
use_cases: fetch historical stock OHLCV for a ticker
export table datasets to CSV for analysis
backtest strategies with historical market data
